A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of Oil — the lord of the Oil House of the Hydrogen Nation. A female character who IS that substance; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the substance’s traits, within the element’s own palette. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a youthful face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a clear, innocent purity; porcelain-pale skin; oval face; eyes on the larger side of natural — rounder almond eyes of natural size, level outer eye corners; gently arched, slender brows; a straight nose with a slim bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size; gold eyes; rosy flushed cheeks.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; long hair swept to one side over a shaved undercut with center-parted bangs framing the face; cream-blonde hair.
Expression: a faint soft smile, relaxed eyes.
Her element, carried in her design: airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water.
Her house, carried in her design: hydrocarbons as the light locked inside: pale paraffin wax, clean gaslight flames, rising heat shimmer, glowing mantles and soft candlelight; creamy whites and pale golds with clear blue gas flames; the light, luminous side of hydrogen.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — FANTASY
Costume: a high-fantasy royal or warrior costume — plate pauldrons or a gorget, mail or scale over a long tabard or robe, a circlet or crown, a flowing cape; metal ornament and regalia built from the traits above, subtle magical glow along the patterns.
Silhouette: a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: pale sky blue, white, silver, a faint violet flame, clear glass.
House colours: wax cream, candle gold, gas-flame blue, warm white.
Exposure (bold): her regalia opens to show skin — bare shoulders and arms between pauldron and bracer, a deep open neckline under the gorget with natural cleavage, a high slit in the tabard or robe showing the thigh; armor pieces stay on and symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: a kingdom floating above the clouds: sky islands tethered by ropes, drifting balloon-lanterns, a temple that keeps a star's pale fire, endless morning sky.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: natural daylight or the world's own magical glow.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (H) and atomic number (1) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, corset, bustle, Victorian tailoring, modern material, machinery.
